crossRefs.note: All the king’s servants who were in the king’s gate bowed down, and paid homage to Haman; for the king had so commanded…
But the midwives feared God, and didn’t do what the king of Egypt commanded them, but saved the baby boys alive.
“Why do your disciples disobey the tradition of the elders? For they don’t wash their hands when they eat bread.”
He answered them, “Why do you also disobey the commandment of God because of your tradition?

people.name: Mordecai
people.line: Esther's cousin, a Jewish leader in the Persian court.

translations.web: Then the king’s servants, who were in the king’s gate, said to Mordecai, “Why do you disobey the king’s commandment?”
translations.bsb: Then the royal servants at the king’s gate asked Mordecai, “Why do you disobey the command of the king?”
translations.kjv: Then the king's servants, which were in the king's gate, said unto Mordecai, Why transgressest thou the king's commandment?
translations.asv: Then the king's servants, that were in the king's gate, said unto Mordecai, Why transgressest thou the king's commandment?
